options.name: Night Operator
options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Last Light Radio channel profile image.
Create ONE original square avatar concept for a fictional late-night radio identity. The creative cue is a quietly eccentric, enigmatic but friendly source of late-night music, a personality that feels like it could inhabit a cozy fictional radio world. It should feel distinctive, warm and a little strange, never threatening or goofy.
Input image 1 is ONLY a brand palette, grain and atmosphere reference. Preserve its midnight navy, warm ivory, aged copper and amber light. Do not put the banner itself in the avatar.
Style: polished illustrated brand portrait with restrained vintage print grain, deliberate bold shapes, beautifully controlled amber light, strong silhouette. Atmospheric, intimate, quietly playful. Avoid photographic realism, clutter, glossy 3D rendering and neon cyberpunk. At most one central character or entity.
Composition: one square image, requested 1024x1024. Entire meaningful subject fits inside a centered circle of radius 390 on a 1024 canvas, with dark breathing room around it. Large central subject, legible as a tiny circular channel avatar. Opaque midnight navy edge-to-edge background.
Text: NONE. No words, letters, names, initials, numerals, frequency labels, slogan, signatures, watermarks, UI or mockup. No actual recognizable person. This is an exploratory branding illustration, not an assertion of approved story canon.
DIRECTION: a single fictional adult late-night radio host in a close head-and-shoulders portrait, three-quarter view. Gender-ambiguous appearance, distinctive unruly soft dark hair, chunky old studio headphones and a loose dark high collar. A compact pair of round smoked glasses catches tiny amber reflections; the rest of the face is softly readable in warm light, with a small knowing, relaxed smile. No exposed glowing supernatural eyes. Friendly but enigmatic, like the unhurried person selecting records after everyone else has gone to sleep. A small warm pool of light rises from below, with a faint amber circle behind the head. Keep facial forms and headphones bold and simple, personality in the silhouette. No microphone, desk or background scenery; focus on this one memorable face.
